comparison.objective: Candidate removes a connector terminal; record relocates a steel plate with a switchable lifting magnet.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine latch access and tool-wire withdrawal versus magnet switching, heavy plate transport/alignment, controlled set-down, and stand return.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits intact and alone versus plate correctly placed before magnet switch-off and magnet returned upright and released.
comparison.reason: The record tests load attachment sequencing and payload placement, not retained-component extraction.
